notes: Generation cost = provider-reported prompt/output/thinking tokens priced at Gemini list prices (2.5 Pro .25/ per 1M, >200k prompt .50/) + estimated embedding tokens at /bin/zsh.15/1M. Baseline runs predate thinking-token metering, so their cost is undercounted and not compared. All three repos ran concurrently with 4 pages in parallel per repo. v3 roughly doubles page count and adds a follow-up pass that documents every file no page cited, so it costs about 2x v2 per repository. hono's v3 time includes waiting out Gemini per-minute quota errors (the generator now backs off on 429 instead of writing error pages). v3 Q&A cost per answer was not metered.
